image_title: Improvement Comparison of TTRL and T³RL
summary: This is a bar chart titled 'Improvement Comparison of TTRL and T³RL' that illustrates the percentage improvement in various math levels (MATH-L1 to MATH-L5) for two methods: TTRL (shown in gray) and T³RL (shown in red). The improvement percentages for MATH-L1, MATH-L2, MATH-L3, MATH-L4, and MATH-L5 are 250% (+0.8%), 225% (+0.5%), 6.3%, 6.7%, and 8.9% respectively. The chart indicates that T³RL shows a consistent upward trend in additional gain, peaking at +8.9% for MATH-L5, while TTRL shows lower improvements across the levels. The y-axis represents improvement percentages, and the x-axis lists the math levels.
